Metadata.title: PT Champion Industrial Indonesia — Fastener & Precision Hardware
Metadata.description: PT Champion Industrial Indonesia manufactures fasteners and precision hardware in Tangerang. More than 44 years of group manufacturing experience since Hong Kong 1982, with strict quality control and readiness for high-volume supply.
Metadata.keywords: fastener, precision hardware, industrial bolts and screws, micro screw, custom OEM parts, fastener factory Tangerang

Hero.title: Fasteners and precision hardware, manufactured in Indonesia.
Hero.subtitle: More than 44 years of fastener manufacturing experience, now continuing in Tangerang. Import-grade quality with strict quality control and readiness for high-volume supply.
Hero.photoAlt: Production line inside a fastener manufacturing facility

About.title: From a small factory in Hong Kong to an industrial network across Asia.
About.paragraph1: What began as a small factory in Hong Kong in 1982 has grown into an integrated fastener and precision hardware group. After more than 44 years, that journey continues in Indonesia through PT Champion Industrial Indonesia, which starts operating in 2026.
About.paragraph2: The Indonesian facility is part of a strategic move to strengthen production capacity, raise quality, and support fastener demand across Southeast Asia. Indonesia is positioned as one of the region’s new strategic hubs in the fastener supply chain.
